description: Optimization-level-2 g1 stress campaign including the deferred k=2 amplification level.
rationale: The controlled g0 repeat showed that optimization_level=2 can substantially reduce compilation-sensitive hardware bias.
The first g1 campaign with optimization_level=0 produced a usable MLAE estimate but both k=0 and k=1 were in the watch region.
Running g1 k=0,1,2 under the same optimization setting avoids mixing compilation regimes in the MLAE estimate.
g1 is the natural next stress test before attempting the deeper quadratic g2 k=2 circuit.

selected_jobs.purpose: Affine encoding stress test with a consistent optimization_level=2 MLAE schedule.

deferred_jobs.reason: Defer until the opt2 g1 stress schedule is retrieved and assessed.
Known degeneracy at a=1/4; use only as an explicit failure-mode demonstration.

stopping_rules: Prepare this campaign without --submit and compare depths against the original opt0 g1 circuits.
Submit only if g1 k=2 remains substantially cheaper than the deferred g2 k=2 circuit.
If g1 k=2 returns a large deviation, pause before submitting g2 k=2 and move to layout or mitigation experiments.
